title: Goodbye Toby
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Goodbye Toby," the office bids farewell to Toby Flenderson as he leaves Dunder Mifflin. Michael plans an extravagant going-away party and meets Toby's replacement, Holly Flax, with whom he quickly develops romantic interest. Jim prepares a fireworks display for the party and plans to propose to Pam. Meanwhile, office dynamics shift with Jan revealing her pregnancy, Andy proposing to Angela, and Dwight orchestrating pranks and hazing against Holly. Toby delivers a heartfelt farewell speech, and the episode explores the evolving relationships and tensions among the staff during this significant transition.
